title: AI search visibility

seo.title: AI search visibility and technical SEO
seo.description: Technical SEO and generative engine optimisation so ChatGPT, Perplexity and AI Overviews cite you, starting with an AI visibility check.

answerBlock: AI search visibility is the work of making your business the one AI assistants and search engines name when a buyer asks who to hire. Calwebtech combines technical SEO with entity clarity, structured data, answer-shaped content and review presence, so ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Google's AI Overviews can find, trust and cite you. It starts with an AI visibility check and continues as monthly work from $1,500 a month.

hero.outcome: Your name in the answer when a buyer asks an assistant who to hire, and a site search engines can crawl, understand and rank.

problem.heading: Why do AI assistants recommend our competitors instead of us?
problem.intro: Buyers now ask assistants as well as search engines, and three problems usually stop a business from being named.

situations.title: Assistants cannot tell what you do
situations.body: Your services, locations and specialisms are described differently on every page and profile, so language models never form a clear picture of the business.

situations.title: The site is hard to crawl and quote
situations.body: Missing structured data, slow pages, duplicate URLs and answers buried in marketing copy make your content hard for search engines and assistants to use.

situations.title: Other sources talk about competitors
situations.body: Reviews, directories and articles mention competitors more often, and assistants lean on those third-party signals when they decide who to name.

included.intro: It starts with an AI visibility check, then runs as monthly work against the gaps the check finds.

faq.heading: What do buyers ask about AI search visibility?

items.question: What is the AI visibility check?
items.answer: We ask ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Google's AI Overviews the questions your buyers ask, record which businesses they name and how they describe you, and audit the technical, entity and content gaps behind the result. You get a written report with the fixes in order of impact.

items.question: Is AI search visibility different from SEO?
items.answer: It builds on it. Most AI systems retrieve candidates from a conventional search index first, so technical SEO is the prerequisite. On top of that, assistants favour clear entities, structured data, answer-shaped content and third-party signals such as reviews.

items.question: Can you guarantee ChatGPT will recommend us?
items.answer: No, and nobody honestly can. Assistants change how they answer, and they weigh signals outside your site. We can fix everything that makes you hard to find, understand and cite, and measure whether you are being named more often.

items.question: How long before we see results?
items.answer: Technical fixes show up in crawling and indexing within weeks. Being named by assistants takes longer, because it depends on content and third-party signals building up, so we review progress quarterly rather than promising a date.

items.question: How do you measure visits from AI assistants?
items.answer: We set up referral tracking so visits and enquiries from assistants are counted separately from search and direct traffic, and every lead records how the person found you, including AI assistants.

items.question: Do we need a new website first?
items.answer: Not usually. Most of the work happens on the site you have. If the check shows the platform itself blocks crawling, speed or structured data, we explain the options and quote a rebuild separately.

items.question: Is there a minimum contract?
items.answer: No. The monthly work is month to month, with no lock-in. If we stop being useful you should be able to leave.
